calls.title: Onboarding Check-in
calls.summary: The team discussed enhancing the SDK integration UI to streamline editing workflows and unify design patterns using modal pop-ups for clarity. They emphasized the need for conditional rendering of payload settings to improve usability, while also maintaining a grid layout for SDK language selection to aid discoverability. The onboarding wizard was outlined as an automation tool for SDK setup but currently only accessible to engineers, posing a gap for other user roles. Efforts to simplify a complex UI for feature and approval flows were also considered, with an emphasis on improving communication and collaboration between design and engineering teams to ensure project timelines are met.
calls.keywords: SDK wizard, onboarding flow, integration design, advanced settings, versioning approval, design-engineering collaboration
